♈ Aries

🔥 Energy: Today the Moon moves through sidereal Capricorn, your 10th house of karma and public standing, under the steady influence of Saturn. This shifts you from yesterday’s questing mood into a more results‑oriented frame. With the Sun in Virgo and Mercury retrograde nearby in your 6th, you’re nudged to clean up the details of work, health and daily systems rather than chase brand‑new adventures. Mars, your ruler, still in Cancer in the 4th, stirs strong feelings around home and family, but the Capricorn Moon asks you to channel that emotion into practical decisions.

💼 Career: The 10th‑house Moon makes this a visible, accountability‑heavy day. Bosses, clients or authorities notice what is delivered, not just what’s promised. Mercury retrograde in your 6th suggests that an old task, file or miscommunication may resurface; instead of getting irritated, see it as a chance to fix something that’s been weakening your reputation. You may need to revise a report, re‑explain a process or take responsibility for a small oversight—doing so calmly actually strengthens trust.

❤️ Love: Mars in your 4th brings emotional intensity behind closed doors, while the Capricorn Moon can make you more reserved in public. If partnered, practical topics—division of chores, long‑term housing plans, or how you both handle stress—take centre stage. Be willing to renegotiate roles without turning it into a scorecard. If single, you may feel more drawn to grounded, hardworking people than to purely exciting ones; notice who shows up consistently rather than who talks the loudest.

💰 Money: The 10th/6th axis highlights income tied to effort, competence and reliability. This isn’t a lottery‑luck day so much as a “what have I actually built?” check‑in. Revisit contracts, billing routines and unpaid invoices; a forgotten payment or under‑charged service may need correcting. Avoid impulsive home‑related spending driven by mood—ask whether a purchase truly supports long‑term comfort or just soothes temporary frustration.

🧘 Advice: Let responsibility be a form of self‑respect rather than a burden. Choose one professional or practical commitment to handle with extra care today; it will echo further than you think.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The task you quietly finish properly today becomes the silent reference point others use to judge your reliability.
taurus:
♉ Taurus

🔥 Energy: With the Moon in Capricorn activating your 9th house, your mind stretches toward bigger questions—ethics, education, travel and long‑range direction. Venus, your ruler, moves steadily through Libra in your 6th, keeping you engaged with the aesthetics and balance of everyday life. Sun plus retrograde Mercury in Virgo in your 5th turn your attention to refining creative work, dealings with children, and how you express joy. It’s a day to align what feels meaningful with what you actually do.

💼 Career: The 9th‑house Moon favours planning, training and strategic decisions. You may rethink a course, certification or long‑term project—especially one you started earlier in the year. Mercury retrograde can bring an old idea back for revision: a proposal, draft or pitch deserves a second, more discriminating look. At work you’re supported in improving the quality of your output rather than increasing quantity. A mentor or senior colleague’s feedback, even if blunt, can be especially useful now.

❤️ Love: With your 5th and 9th houses lit, love and philosophy intertwine. If partnered, conversations about shared beliefs, parenting approaches or how you spend leisure time become relevant. You may realise you’ve been compromising too much on what you actually enjoy doing together. If single, you’re more likely to connect through learning spaces—classes, workshops, spiritual communities—than through purely social scenes. Pay attention to who respects your pacing instead of pushing for more than you’re ready to share.

💰 Money: Capricorn’s influence on your 9th can bring attention to bigger‑ticket expenses linked to education, travel or legal matters. This is a good day to price out options realistically: tuition, retreat fees, relocation costs or visas. Sun/Mercury in your 5th ask you to review spending on hobbies, entertainment and children—where can you keep the joy but trim the waste? A past expenditure may need follow‑up, such as a refund, correction or missing item; don’t hesitate to chase it.

🧘 Advice: Let your standards rise in a way that feels supportive, not punishing. You’re allowed to want both beauty and integrity in how you live.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When you stop treating your real interests as a side note, life begins rearranging practical doors to support them.
gemini:
♊ Gemini

🔥 Energy: Today’s Capricorn Moon moves through your 8th house of shared resources, psychological depth and long‑standing entanglements, prompting you to look beneath surface agreements. Mercury, your ruler, is retrograde in Virgo in your 4th, stirring reviews around home, family conversations and emotional foundations. The combination points to a day of practical truth‑telling: noticing where old patterns around security, dependence or secrecy need updating.

💼 Career: The 8th‑house Moon favours behind‑the‑scenes work—budget reviews, contract clauses, partnerships, taxes or benefits. You might discover a detail that was glossed over earlier, especially related to family business, remote work from home, or property matters. Mercury retrograde in your 4th can also reconnect you with a past client or project tied to your living situation. Approach negotiations calmly and factually; this is less about dramatic ultimatums and more about clarifying terms so that responsibilities are fair on all sides.

❤️ Love: Emotional realism takes the lead. If partnered, money, commitment and emotional honesty are on the table. You or your partner may want clearer boundaries around shared expenses, privacy at home, or where extended family fits into your life together. If single, you could feel drawn to someone who seems intense, private or healing‑oriented—but take your time; the 8th house can blur the line between genuine intimacy and projection. Ask yourself whether you feel more empowered or more anxious after interacting with them.

💰 Money: This is a day to look carefully at joint accounts, loans, insurance, inheritances or any financial matter that links you with others. Capricorn’s influence helps you see the numbers without panic. You may choose to consolidate, renegotiate or slowly disentangle from an arrangement that no longer feels balanced. At the same time, review home‑related expenses—rent, repairs, utilities—for errors or outdated contracts; a small correction now can save ongoing leakage.

🧘 Advice: Instead of trying to think your way around uncomfortable topics, let yourself look at them directly with grounded curiosity. Clarity is quieter than fear.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The boundary you put around shared resources today is really a boundary around how much of yourself you give away unconsciously.
cancer:
♋ Cancer

🔥 Energy: The Moon, your ruler, travels through Capricorn, directly opposite your sign, emphasising your 7th house of partnerships and agreements. You’re more attuned than usual to how others show up—and to where you may have been over‑functioning. With Sun and retrograde Mercury in Virgo in your 3rd, important conversations, documents and short trips are highlighted. Mars in your sign keeps your will strong, but the Capricorn Moon asks you to temper emotion with structure.

💼 Career: Today’s focus is on contracts, clients and collaborators. The 7th‑house Moon can bring a key meeting, negotiation or feedback session, or simply make you more aware of how cooperative or resistant others have become. Mercury retrograde suggests revisiting an earlier agreement: a scope of work, partnership terms, or communication protocol that needs updating. Instead of shouldering extra tasks automatically, invite shared planning and written clarity. Clear roles now prevent resentment later.

❤️ Love: Relationships come into sharp, realistic focus. If partnered, you may notice where everyday communication has grown rushed or vague. This is a good day to set aside time for a grounded talk about schedules, decisions and mutual expectations, especially around siblings, neighbours or travel. If single, you might reconnect with a person from your local environment or your recent past. Notice whether this reconnection feels stabilising or drains your energy; you’re not obligated to reopen an old dynamic just because it returns.

💰 Money: Joint financial decisions—shared rent, bills, subscriptions, or business partnerships—are highlighted. The Capricorn Moon supports sober assessment: who is paying what, by when, and under which conditions. Meanwhile, small day‑to‑day expenses like transport, phone plans and errands deserve a review; a modest adjustment in these 3rd‑house costs can ease pressure more than you’d expect. Avoid agreeing to financial commitments just to avoid temporary awkwardness.

🧘 Advice: Let other people carry their share of the weight. You can still be nurturing without automatically stepping into the role of emotional or logistical parent.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The limit you calmly state to another person today is also a quiet promise to your own nervous system.
leo:
♌ Leo

🔥 Energy: With the Moon in Capricorn moving through your 6th house, the spotlight falls on work routines, health habits and how you manage time. The Sun, your ruler, is in Virgo in your 2nd, joined by retrograde Mercury, bringing a practical review of income, skills and expenditure. Hidden Mars in Cancer in your 12th can stir background restlessness or old frustrations, making it especially important to ground yourself in tangible tasks.

💼 Career: This is a get‑things‑in‑order day rather than a showy one. The 6th‑house Moon supports system upgrades, clearing backlogs, refining checklists and improving how your workspace runs. Sun/Mercury in your 2nd suggest revisiting how your work is valued—are you using your strengths in ways that are actually recognised, or doing too much invisible labour? Old invoices, contracts or salary discussions may resurface. Approach them with calm facts instead of drama; steady self‑advocacy serves you better than a grand gesture now.

❤️ Love: The practical side of relationships comes into focus: who handles which errands, how you divide responsibilities, and how lifestyle choices affect the bond. If partnered, small adjustments in day‑to‑day cooperation can have more impact than big romantic statements today. If single, you may notice attraction sparking in pragmatic environments—at work, in a class, or while running chores. Pay attention to people who show reliability and kindness in small ways; that’s the energy that matches today’s sky.

💰 Money: With the Sun illuminating your 2nd house, this is a strong day for budgeting and resource planning. Mercury retrograde favours reviewing subscriptions, renegotiating a service, or reconsidering the pricing of your offerings. The 6th‑house Moon links finances to habits: what you consistently do with your time either supports or undermines your earning capacity. Small, sustainable changes—like structuring your mornings differently—can quietly improve your financial picture over the next few weeks.

🧘 Advice: Let humility and precision guide you. You don’t have to perform your worth; you only need to organise your life so it reflects what you truly value.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The unglamorous tweak you make to your routine today may free more creative energy than any burst of inspiration.
virgo:
♍ Virgo

The Sun is in your sign and Mercury, your ruler, is retrograde there, turning your attention inward: how you present yourself, how you speak, and which labels you’ve outgrown. Mars and Jupiter in Cancer continue to energise your 11th house of networks and future plans, but today’s mood is more about refining than expanding.

The 5th‑house Moon supports bringing craftsmanship to creative projects; you can add structure to ideas that were previously only half‑formed. Mercury retrograde in your 1st may bring an old professional identity or title up for review. If partnered, you may feel drawn to shared activities that involve building or making something together—cooking, planning a garden, working on a home project—rather than purely consuming entertainment. If single, you might reconsider what kind of person you truly enjoy, beyond your usual “type.” Someone who appears reserved could reveal a warm, dependable side as you get to know them; give slower‑burn connections room to unfold.

💰 Money: The 5th‑house Moon highlights spending on children, hobbies and creative ventures. You’re encouraged to distinguish between investments that nurture your talents and impulse purchases that clutter your life. Sun/Mercury in your 1st also support renegotiating fees or roles if you’ve been under‑charging for your expertise. Look back at past offers or opportunities you declined or mishandled; one of them may now be ready for a more mature, mutually beneficial second attempt.

🧘 Advice: Treat self‑revision as an art form, not a crisis. You’re allowed to change your mind about how you show up in the world without discarding your core.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The story you stop telling about yourself today makes room for a version of you that fits more comfortably and works more effectively.
libra:
♎ Libra

🔥 Energy: Today the Moon in Capricorn passes through your 4th house, bringing attention to home life, emotional roots and private responsibilities. Venus in your sign keeps you socially appealing, but the inner focus is stronger than yesterday. With Sun and retrograde Mercury in Virgo in your 12th, unconscious patterns, sleep and old memories come to the surface. This is a day to quietly stabilise your base rather than overextend yourself outward.

💼 Career: Outwardly you can maintain grace, but the skies favour background adjustments more than public pushes. The 4th‑house Moon encourages reorganising your workspace or home office, updating files, and clarifying boundaries between work and personal time. Mercury retrograde in your 12th may bring back an old worry or behind‑the‑scenes issue—a confidential email thread, a private disagreement, or a task that slipped through the cracks. Handle it discreetly and methodically; there’s no need for drama, just correction.

❤️ Love: Emotional safety is the real topic now. If partnered, you may feel a stronger need for reassurance, quiet time together or simple domestic rituals that soothe the nervous system. It’s a good day to talk gently about what each of you needs from “home” to feel at ease. If single, you might feel less inclined to chase new connections and more drawn to understanding why past dynamics unfolded the way they did. A reflective mood can be healing if you don’t use it to blame yourself for everything.

💰 Money: Home‑related expenses, rent, repairs or family support may require attention. Capricorn’s influence helps you make grounded decisions rather than emotionally driven ones. Sun/Mercury in the 12th also highlight hidden financial patterns: automatic payments, quiet generosity, or self‑sabotaging purchases that happen when you’re tired or stressed. Take a private look at your statements and identify one recurring leak you’re ready to plug.

🧘 Advice: Make space for rest without labelling it laziness. Strengthening your inner foundation now will let your natural charm flow without strain later.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The small way you choose to protect your peace at home today becomes a model for how you protect your energy everywhere else.
scorpio:
♏ Scorpio

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Capricorn activates your 3rd house of communication, siblings, neighbours and short‑term plans, bringing a serious, task‑oriented tone to your interactions. Mars, your traditional ruler, continues in Cancer in your 9th, fuelling a push toward broader learning or travel, while Jupiter there expands your hunger for meaning. Sun and retrograde Mercury in Virgo in your 11th link this to networks and long‑term goals. Today is about putting structure around big ideas through concrete steps.

💼 Career: The 3rd‑house Moon supports writing, teaching, meetings and negotiations—but in a no‑nonsense style. You’re well‑placed to clarify timelines, set expectations and ask pointed questions. Mercury retrograde in your 11th could reconnect you with a former team, collaborator or community project. An old initiative may be worth reviving, but only if it fits your current values and time capacity. Avoid vague promises; put agreements in writing and be clear about what’s experimental versus committed.

❤️ Love: Conversation matters more than fireworks today. If partnered, you may discuss shared plans, mutual friends, or travel ideas with greater realism—what can you truly afford, and how will it fit into daily life? Misunderstandings from recent weeks can be smoothed out by calmly revisiting them with new information. If single, pay attention to who you genuinely enjoy talking to; someone in your wider circle or online community may reveal a deeper compatibility as you exchange practical help and ideas.

💰 Money: Short‑term financial decisions—subscriptions, commuting costs, devices, small business tools—are highlighted. The Capricorn Moon favours signing sensible agreements, but Mercury retrograde urges you to double‑check terms before committing. In group or friendship contexts, be cautious about lending or mixing money and goodwill; if you choose to help, do it with clear boundaries and no unspoken expectations. Also consider how education or travel investments (9th house) line up with your actual earning trajectory.

🧘 Advice: Let practicality and honesty guide your words. You don’t need to soften every truth, only to deliver it with the respect you’d like to receive.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The email, message or conversation you handle with clear edges today can quietly change the trajectory of a relationship or project.
sagittarius:
♐ Sagittarius

❤️ Love: Financial and emotional security may feel intertwined. Aim for problem‑solving rather than accusation. If single, you may find your standards shifting: instead of being drawn purely to adventure, you might feel more attraction to those who demonstrate reliability and self‑respect in how they manage their own lives.

A practical tweak to your earning strategy—like adjusting your rates or refining where you look for opportunities—can be particularly fruitful now.

🧘 Advice: Treat money as feedback, not a verdict. Use what you see in your accounts today to adjust course rather than to judge your worth.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The way you choose to value your time and skills today quietly teaches the world how to value them too.
capricorn:
♑ Capricorn

🔥 Energy: The Moon moves through your own sign, illuminating your 1st house and bringing your feelings and responsibilities to the forefront. Saturn, your ruler, continues its long transit through Pisces in your 3rd, giving depth and weight to your words. With Sun and retrograde Mercury in Virgo in your 9th, you’re revisiting beliefs, study plans or travel ideas. The focus shifts from working in the background to standing more fully in your own authority—quietly, not theatrically.

💼 Career: The Moon in your sign increases your visibility and sense of personal accountability. People may look to you to make decisions or stabilise a wavering situation. Sun/Mercury in your 9th favour reviewing contracts or projects that involve teaching, publishing, foreign contacts or legal matters. You may decide to adjust a long‑term plan—changing timelines, refining a curriculum, or renegotiating terms with a distant partner. Be willing to say “this no longer fits” and suggest a structured alternative.

❤️ Love: Your emotional state is more influential than usual in your relationships. If partnered, your need for respect and reliability is strong; you may feel less patient with vagueness or broken small promises. Use this as a cue to articulate your standards calmly rather than withdrawing. If single, you might draw attention simply by carrying yourself with grounded self‑containment. Conversations with people from different backgrounds or belief systems can be especially stimulating—notice who listens as carefully as they speak.

💰 Money: The 1st/9th axis highlights how personal decisions shape long‑term financial horizons. You may revisit plans related to higher education, travel, relocation or legal settlements and how they impact your budget. Mercury retrograde suggests it’s wise to re‑read documents and seek clarification on ambiguous clauses. This is less about dramatic gains and more about preventing slow leaks or misalignments. A modest but clear re‑prioritisation today can significantly ease your load later.

🧘 Advice: Allow yourself to be a work in progress without compromising your integrity. Adjusting your path isn’t a failure of discipline; it’s discipline applied to new information.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The decision you quietly make about what you will and won’t carry anymore becomes a turning point others only understand in hindsight.
aquarius:
♒ Aquarius
